## `dist.all_reduce`

Combine a sharded tensor's per-device pieces across a mesh with `fn`, replicated to every device (the sec-140 collective). Pure; result type == input type.

dist.all_reduce(%input) {mesh, fn} -> %result. Combine a sharded tensor across a mesh and replicate to every device (sec-68/sec-140 collective). Pure. ⛔ result type == input type -- an all-reduce PRESERVES shape (it combines partials, not an axis-reduce; sec-70: the semantic annotation, the executing tier realizes the communication). Determinism rides the executing tier (tensor.reduce's order-sensitivity note). find_dist_misuse: operand + result Tensor-kinded (OperandNotTensor); result type == input type (ResultTypeMismatch); `mesh` resolves to a dist.mesh (UnknownMesh); `fn` in {sum,prod,max,min} (FnInvalid -- tensor.reduce's vocab minus mean, the 30a-3 post-scale named-forward). The generated verify_all_reduce owns the STRUCTURAL contract (1 operand, 1 result, mesh+fn present+kind).

## `dist.mesh`

Declare a named device mesh (a logical grid of devices); referenced by dist.shard/dist.all_reduce. NOT Pure (a named declaration, not a value).

dist.mesh() {name, shape}. A named device-mesh declaration (sec-68): the logical grid dist.shard places tensors onto and dist.all_reduce reduces across.
